The 200:85 rounded rink proportion, both zone lines, centre line, all five faceoff circles, both clipped goal lines, two rear goal footprints and two front crease shapes remain. End faceoff circles use 7 mm radii and the central circle an 8 mm radius to preserve its two halves. These circles are reduced relative to the rink to make room for enlarged 8 mm goal footprints and 17 mm-wide crease shapes. The crease arcs are simplified quadratic curves. These circles are reduced relative to the rink to make room for enlarged 8 mm goal footprints and 17 mm-wide crease shapes. The crease arcs are simplified quadratic curves.
